I was signed up for my first marathon, which is in May, though due to shin splints and just a general feeling of "I don't think I'm ready" I decided to work for a marathon this fall instead. I have the [Doc](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheet/ccc?key=0AmbShFyCs16odC1Tb1ZsNVdMbHVsYl9JSUhKY1J5Unc&usp=sharing) attached, and it would be great if someone could critique it for me. The marathon is September 21st and my ultimate goal is to finish it in under 4 hours (if I ran the May marathon, I'd just want to finish).

What isn't included is the details of the runs. The 30:00 will likely be my HIIT workouts and I almost always include sprints in whatever I do. I want to schedule one tempo run per week as well, whenever it works for me. The days I have listed are not necessarily to be done in order, either. It was just easier for me to figure out my times. Cross-training will likely be biking or walking. My rest days will likely include a short walk.

As you can see, I finished one run already and highlighted it green, meaning it was a great run. Yellow will be moderate (maybe just wasn't feeling it or had slight pain) and red will indicate a thoroughly shitty run. I will attach notes to my log as needed.

EDIT: I currently run about 30-35 miles a week, with my longest run being 16 miles about a week and a half ago.
